items.duty_text: Review the educational materials annually and update them as needed.
The donation process must include public notification describing the surplus software and equipment and any total shipping and handling fees.

observation.label: Awaiting an evidence detector
observation.note: No evidence detector for “data publication” yet.

items.duty_text: The donation process must provide eligible organizations an opportunity to submit competitive proposals for beneficial use.
The department shall not donate surplus software or equipment unless the recipient has demonstrated a need and specific plans for beneficial use.

When multiple eligible organizations qualify for the same surplus software or equipment, the department shall donate it to the organization whose need and beneficial use will result in the greatest public good, using factors established by rule.

For surplus equipment needing repair or restoration, the department shall prioritize donation to an eligible organization offering to use the repair or restoration in student training, with the equipment returned after repair or restoration for subsequent donation.
The department shall not auction or dispose of surplus software or equipment unless no eligible organization responds with a need and specific plan over the course of one year.
items.deadline_text: over the course of one year

items.duty_text: The department shall not transfer ownership of software when the transfer would breach a software license agreement or infringe copyright.
Establish and implement a public service corps program pursuant to which undergraduate and graduate students may complete internships at agencies.
Make efforts to recruit students from diverse backgrounds and offer internships at a broad range of agencies.
Ensure all civil service exams being administered for the public are also administered in city correctional facilities.
Waive the civil service exam fee for specified incarcerated individuals and individuals enrolled in qualifying reentry or alternatives-to-incarceration services.
Install all solar canopies that would be cost-effective at each city-controlled parking lot, with the cooperation of all other relevant agencies.
items.deadline_text: No later than two years after the effective date of this section

items.duty_text: Equip at least 50 percent of parking spaces covered by installed solar canopies with electrical raceways capable of supporting electric vehicle charging stations, and install electric vehicle charging stations for those spaces.
The commissioner shall create an online anonymous workplace culture survey designed to elicit information related to workplace culture, with specified instructions and questions.
items.deadline_text: No later than July 1, 2025

items.duty_text: The department shall coordinate with agencies to distribute the workplace culture survey link to all employees for voluntary completion.
items.deadline_text: No later than September 1, 2025, and each September 1 annually thereafter

items.duty_text: Offer career counseling to employees of the city civil service.
Offer career counseling to eligible employees.
Conduct a 60-minute career counseling session with each requesting eligible employee.
items.deadline_text: within 60 days of an eligible employee’s request

items.duty_text: Conduct at least one follow-up call to each eligible employee who participates in a career counseling session.
items.deadline_text: within 30 days of such career counseling session

items.duty_text: Offer voluntary electronic surveys to relevant employees upon completion of a career counseling session, including questions designed to obtain information required for the annual report.

The donation process must include public notification describing the surplus software and equipment and any total shipping and handling fees.

observation.label: Awaiting an evidence detector

items.duty_text: The donation process must provide eligible organizations an opportunity to submit competitive proposals for beneficial use.
The department shall not donate surplus software or equipment unless the recipient has demonstrated a need and specific plans for beneficial use.

When multiple eligible organizations qualify for the same surplus software or equipment, the department shall donate it to the organization whose need and beneficial use will result in the greatest public good, using factors established by rule.

For surplus equipment needing repair or restoration, the department shall prioritize donation to an eligible organization offering to use the repair or restoration in student training, with the equipment returned after repair or restoration for subsequent donation.
The department shall not auction or dispose of surplus software or equipment unless no eligible organization responds with a need and specific plan over the course of one year.
items.deadline_text: over the course of one year

items.duty_text: The department shall not transfer ownership of software when the transfer would breach a software license agreement or infringe copyright.
Establish and implement a public service corps program pursuant to which undergraduate and graduate students may complete internships at agencies.
Make efforts to recruit students from diverse backgrounds and offer internships at a broad range of agencies.
Ensure all civil service exams being administered for the public are also administered in city correctional facilities.
Waive the civil service exam fee for specified incarcerated individuals and individuals enrolled in qualifying reentry or alternatives-to-incarceration services.
Install all solar canopies that would be cost-effective at each city-controlled parking lot, with the cooperation of all other relevant agencies.
items.deadline_text: No later than two years after the effective date of this section

items.duty_text: Equip at least 50 percent of parking spaces covered by installed solar canopies with electrical raceways capable of supporting electric vehicle charging stations, and install electric vehicle charging stations for those spaces.
